We’re looking for a Data (BI/DWH) Developer to join one of our Data Warehouse & BI teams. You’ll design, develop, and maintain enterprise data warehouse solutions, ETL/ELT pipelines, and reporting data structures that enable trusted, scalable, and high-performing analytics. You’ll work closely with Technical Data Analysts, Data Engineers, Data Modellers, BI Developers, and business stakeholders to transform business requirements into reliable data solutions.

 • Implement ETL/ELT processes to integrate data from multiple source systems.
 • Develop scalable and reusable data integration solutions following established development standards.
 • Translate technical specifications and source-to-target mappings into robust implementations.
 • Collaborate with Solution Architects and Technical Data Analysts to ensure alignment with business requirements.
 • Produce and maintain technical documentation for developed solutions.

 • Implement business transformation logic based on approved functional and technical specifications.
 • Integrate structured and semi-structured data from various enterprise systems.
 • Ensure data consistency, integrity, and completeness throughout integration processes.
 • Support incremental loading strategies and performance optimization.
 • Troubleshoot and resolve issues affecting data integration workflows.

 • Implement indexing and partitioning strategies where appropriate.
 • Analyze execution plans and identify opportunities for performance improvements.
 • Ensure database developments comply with security and development standards.
 • Support database maintenance and continuous optimization initiatives.
